extraFacts.fact: SAE J514 is the standard for 37° flared (JIC) tube fittings, whose flare seats on a 74° included cone; SAE J512 covers the 45° SAE flare, a different seat that does not seal against the 37° flare.

NPTF (Dryseal) is standardised in ASME B1.20.3: a taper pipe thread cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread. NPSM is a straight (parallel) pipe thread under ASME B1.20.1 and does not seal on the thread.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.3 and ASME B1.20.1 scopes

extraFacts.fact: SAE J1453 covers O-ring face seal (ORFS) fittings, and SAE J1926 / ISO 11926 covers straight-thread O-ring boss (ORB) ports; both seal on an O-ring, not on the thread.
ISO 228-1 covers BSP parallel pipe threads, which do not seal on the thread; a 60° cone BSPP connection seals on the cone (ISO 8434-6).
DIN 2353 / ISO 8434-1 covers metric tube fittings with a 24° cone; the L series is the light series and the S series the heavy series, each with its own tube sizes and threads.
Hose and fitting dash sizes count sixteenths of an inch: -3 is 3/16 inch, -4 is 1/4 inch, -6 is 3/8 inch, -8 is 1/2 inch, -12 is 3/4 inch and -16 is 1 inch.
extraFacts.source: SAE J514 / ISO 8434 dash size convention; row data of the Parker 56 Series listings
